resources.string: Phone Monitor
Update Android System WebView to use Phone Monitor. This device must support secure web messages. Reopen the app after updating.
Pair with laptop
Connect USB, start hub pairing on the laptop, then enter the 8-digit code it prints. The code expires after 2 minutes.
8-digit code
Pair
Cancel
Pairing…
That code was not accepted. Check the 8 digits on the laptop and try again.
Laptop not reachable over USB. Check the cable, USB debugging authorization, and that the hub is in pairing mode.
Pairing did not complete. Try again.
Controller Wi-Fi
Enter the light controller\'s network name and password. Android asks once to approve this local network; it has no internet, and USB to the laptop keeps working.

Check the network name (1–32 bytes) and password (8–63 plain characters).
Waiting for Android to approve and join the controller network…
Wi-Fi access permission was not granted. You can join the controller network in Wi-Fi settings instead.
This Android version needs Location turned on to request a Wi-Fi network. Turn Location on, then tap Connect controller again.
Android did not join the controller network (declined, not found, or wrong password). You can try again or use Wi-Fi settings.
Joined the network, but the light controller did not answer at its address. Check the controller is powered and try again.
